title: Cheesy Crêpes
description: Half pancake, half omelette — light, easy crêpes made from eggs, low-fat cream cheese and spring onions. A super-quick midweek supper.
steps: Lightly whisk the eggs, add 100g of the cream cheese and whisk until smooth and pale. Stir in the spring onions (holding back a tablespoon to serve). Let the batter stand for 30 minutes.
Heat 0.5 teaspoon of oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Test heat with a tiny drop of batter — if it sizzles, it's ready.
Pour in half the batter, cook for 2–3 minutes, flip carefully and cook the other side for the same time. Repeat.
Arrange both crêpes on a plate, top with remaining cream cheese and spring onions.
notes: Each batch (2 crêpes) serves 1. Multiply as needed. Swap spring onions for mushrooms, tomatoes or sliced peppers.
